markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: As of August 2026, trader consensus prices JD Vance highest among potential 2028 nominees, reflecting his position as sitting vice president and alignment with the incumbent administration, while Marco Rubio’s share stems from his role as secretary of state and recent polling gains in early primary states. The Democratic side remains fragmented, with Gavin Newsom, Jon Ossoff, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez clustered near the top amid low single-digit support for figures such as Kamala Harris. Prediction markets show a narrow overall edge for Democrats in party-level contracts, driven by broader economic and foreign-policy pressures, yet the wide distribution of individual probabilities underscores an open field nearly two years before primaries begin. Scheduled debates, midterm results, and administration actions on trade or security could widen gaps among contenders.
